title: Python Len Protocol Diagnosis
objective: Characterize public len protocol and private host-length dependencies without changing core behavior

handoff.summary: Tests/docs-only diagnosis: 22 CPython 3.14 comparisons and 11 host probes against read-only qualified artifact 419a10fb1; no core edits or builds. Thirteen differences include length protocol failures and surrogate representation collapse.
risks: Reporting diagnostic success does not mean public semantics match CPython.
Standard lane build/compiler/integration validation was intentionally not run: this task prohibits builds and relies on an explicitly identified historical artifact.
next_steps: Review public/private len split before changing the shared helper.
Treat Unicode representation as a separately scoped correctness decision.
